dedupe_keys.name: cmab a multi attribute building dataset of china

description: CMAB: A Multi-Attribute Building Dataset of China is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Yecheng Zhang et al. Rapidly acquiring three-dimensional (3D) building data, including geometric attributes like rooftop, height and orientations, as well as indicative attributes like function, quality, and age, supports urban analysis, simulations, and policy updates. Current building datasets suffer from incomplete coverage of building multi-attributes. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2025. Formats: Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 15515524096 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
